stem: What happens next in this passage after “Scientists explained that mangroves can protect coasts from waves, provide fish habitat, and store carbon.”?
options: The project began after a heat study showed where pedestrians suffered most.
A tree near the park was cut down after a storm.
After a storm, the area behind the mangroves suffered less damage than nearby open shore.
A clear lake became cloudy after years of nearby farming and construction.
